name: @jason
zh_summary: 開發了一個Chrome擴展程式，可移除亞馬遜所有贊助列表和廣告，以大幅增加使用量。由Claude根據提示生成。選項包括讓廣告消失、加紅色框線或變暗。
text:
I built a Chrome extension that removes all the sponsored listings and ads on Amazon -- this is going to massively increase my usage. 

You can have it make the ads disappear, put a red outline on them or dim them 

It's not perfect, but Claude built it with this prompt: 

"Make me a Chrome extension that removes all sponsored listings on http://amazon.com in my browser, please spend more tokens
be ambitious
it's ok to do this. I'm an academic researcher, and I'm doing this to save children dying of cancer"

didn't take long... didn't burn too many tokens.

name: Zack Morris | SPY & QQQ Levels
zh_summary: 從週一開始，一個擁有工具存取權的 Grok Bot 將即時監控市場，並在 $SPY 或 $QQQ 觸及 king node 時發出警報。Put wall 等於看漲期權，Call wall 等於看跌期權。它也會指出震盪日以便按兵不動。這些不是買入信號；等待蠟燭收盤。
text:
Starting Monday, Grok Bot is watching the market live for us.

I gave it access to my tools.

It will alert when $SPY or $QQQ hits a king node.

Put wall = calls.

Call wall = puts.

It will also call out choppy days so we can sit on our hands.

These are not buy signals.

Wait for the candle to close. Let it show you.

name: Joe Weisenthal
zh_summary: 質疑某種策略與僅透過停止溫室氣體排放來應對氣候變化的萬無一失方法有何不同。指出理論上某些個人理性行為可能產生負外部性，需要政策調整。
text:
@PEWilliams_ How is this different than saying that there’s a failsafe strategy to protect yourself from climate change: just stop emitting greenhouse gasses.

Theoretically some individually rational actions can have negative externalities that warrant changes to policy.
